definitions: Belonging to a particular place by birth.
Of or relating to the place or environment in which a person was born or a thing originated.
Existing in or belonging to a person or thing from birth or origin.
Denoting a person born in a specified place or associated with a place by birth, whether or not they currently reside there.
examples: He is a native speaker of English.
The koala is native to Australia.
She returned to her native land.
